title: Chapter 804
paragraphs: Chapter 804
Episode 199. The Majesty of the Plutonian Tribe’s 13th Battle King (1)
Kwa-Dd-Dd-Dung...!
A crimson lightning was pouring down over the main building of the 3rd branch of Kinzelo. It was the lightning attack cast by the enemy tribe who had just completed space leap.
Just like when the land branch of the Beastmen was destroyed, normally, the fight would be over the moment the enemy's lightning fell. What follows should have been one-sided hunting.
But this time, the enemy tribe couldn't immediately claim their trophies as they usually would.

A blue lightning far larger than what they had just cast was resonating across the 3rd branch. The enemy tribe members who were about to enter the building stopped their actions and turned their heads.
"Brothers of Andol, this power... it's him!"
"Jin Run Candle, he's here!"
As the enemy tribes roared all at once, the nearby space distorted. Kinzelo's Beastmen who were close by fell to the ground, blood pouring from their ears.
Their hearts were glowing red. The culprit who killed their brothers, the descendant of the Blue Clan who they must tear apart and kill, has appeared.
Furthermore, unlike the day when Shimat and his party first came to the surface, more than thirty of their brothers are with them, and all are led directly by the Battle King Rakiman Hog.
It was time to avenge their brothers.
"Quite a crowd has gathered."

Jin, who revealed himself in the front yard of the 3rd branch, said, looking around at the enemy tribes. The enemy tribe was lined up behind Rakiman. Because Jin moved too quickly, Bishkel had not yet arrived.
Jin's and Rakiman's eyes collided.

"It seems you're Rakiman Hog, the Battle King of the enemy tribe. You should have just stayed underground, why come out and make a fuss? I clearly warned Shimat that it would be best for the enemy tribe to hide well from now on."

"We've lived without distinguishing between the surface and the underground. We were only asleep due to the numbers of the Great Snake. As the original masters return, wouldn't it be right for you to step aside?"

"Yeah, yeah. You're not the kind who can communicate well, Rakiman. Shimat, on the other hand, seemed to have some sense of reality. Rakiman, can't you realize that your opponent is vastly stronger than you?"
Schreee...!
Jin drew his sword, Sigmund.
"To my eyes, you're just a bizarre hybrid. Human and Blue Clan... Seeing it directly is even stranger than I imagined."
Rakiman also formed two giant swords with his Red Lightning. He possessed a distinctly stronger aura than when he confronted Badrei and Berakt. It was the result of hunting Kinzelo over time.

"You keep calling me a member of the Blue Clan since the last time, but I am the 13th Battle King of the noble Myeong Clan. The title Myeong King, you have never been able to fully claim it even once. Today, you will understand why. I'll show you the gap."
Tsuaak-!

As soon as he finished speaking, the blue lightning that had been gathered in the sky was restored to Jin, causing the ground to tremble. The average warriors unknowingly swallowed dry saliva at Jin's suddenly exploding energy.
The feeling of suffocation was simply from looking at it. The air became infinitely heavy in an instant, and it felt like their brothers standing right next to them were moving away.
"We need to adjust our eye levels first. It's not right for the likes of the enemy tribe to look down on the Myeong King... If you're tall, it's right to at least kneel."

Rakiman charged, swinging his dual swords, but the Lightning Qi formed like a protective barrier blocked his path. The Lightning Qi was shattered by the dual swords but immediately restored, and the dual swords repeatedly cut through the empty air without reaching their target.

Meanwhile, the average enemy tribe warriors behind him were indeed kneeling one by one. They couldn't withstand the pressure from the blue Lightning Qi that Jin was releasing. The Battle Kings like Andolin were protecting the warriors by repelling the Lightning Qi, but it was only for a moment.
Then the Myeong King Army Swordsmanship began.
Myeong King Sword Battle Skill, 10th Sword
Myeong King Army Sword - Opening
The fifth of the Battle God that symbolizes the peak of the Myeong King.

Only the Myeong Kings, or those who possess the same level as them, can proudly stand in that blue and massive storm. Only those could enjoy the privilege of being able to fight without faltering even in the Myeong King Army Swordsmanship.
The average enemy tribe warriors do not meet this condition. Already, twenty-seven average warriors were kneeling, bleeding from every hole in their faces.

Now the Myeong King Army Swordsmanship that Jin unfolds is not at the incomplete stage as before. It is only lacking compared to the half, an accomplished realm that would have been perfect for the position of the Battle God right away if it weren't for her era.
So it was natural that the enemy tribe's average warriors would either die or faint immediately.
Even those called Battle Kings within the enemy tribe couldn't handle that energy.
"Khek...!"

Andolin and the 2nd and 3rd rank Battle Kings also sat down on the ground, spitting blood in mouthfuls. The blood spilled by the enemy tribe evaporated without a moment's delay in the air or on the ground, scattered in the Lightning Qi.
[Myeong King Army Sword, honor the privilege of facing this sword. Every time you face me in the future, always act like now. Meaning, either kneel or prostrate.]

The deep, resonant voice as if overlapped by hundreds of Myeong Kings shook the battlefield. Amidst the rumbling thunder from all over, the enemies could clearly hear that low voice. It was horrifying and vivid as if it was tearing through their ears and coming into their minds.
Among the enemies, Rakiman Hogman was still standing intact, gradually closing the distance with Jin.

'If it weren't for the special ability called "Beast Butcher", he would never have overwhelmed Berakt and Badrei, but still, the status of a Grand Warrior is not lacking. It's clear that he hasn't fully regained his strength yet, but he's already this far.'
ROOOAAAR!
Every time Rakiman roared, a red spot appeared in the area of the King's Domain. He was securing his own space without being crushed by the blue energy.
He still hadn't fully recovered. The red energy radiating from Rakiman was only about half of its peak.
However, Rakiman did not brag about that fact.
Jin was clearly an opponent he could never beat one-on-one, even at his peak, he clearly realized this.
"It's a wonder the Shimat tribesmen survived, Jin Runcandel!"

'[Back then, I had many questions I wanted to ask you, so I saved you out of curiosity. But not today. If you have anything to show, bring it out. Use your power as a Grand Warrior to summon more reinforcements, or transform into a Castleization.]'
"The Great Serpent has told us about you."
'[Or, like Shimat did, are you going to use your tribesmen as a catalyst and escape using a return spell?]'
"Gah!"
Rakiman swiped at Sigmund and rolled on the ground. Jin, who had been in sight all along, suddenly disappeared and attacked him.
He regained his balance and raised his dual swords. Jin was still nowhere to be seen, and Rakiman heightened his senses, feeling his marrow freezing.
He couldn't predict where Jin's sword would emerge. The King's Domain's lightning was constantly obscuring Jin like fog.
If he had fully regained his strength, he could have fought against the lightning of the King's Domain by spreading Castleization.
Of course, that would only mean prolonging the battle. After all, no matter what Rakiman did on his own, he could never beat Jin.
Moreover, Rakiman instinctively realized that the King's Domain was a five-part skill. Now it was only at the beginning stage, he wouldn't be able to withstand the next stage like he is now.
'The King's Domain, huh? I can see why the deity of the Blue Plutonian tribe at that time would rise to such a level. There must be a next stage, is he saving it due to physical strain?'
As Rakiman predicted, the King's Domain still placed a lot of burden on Jin. There was no reason to unfold it against an opponent he could easily overpower with his dog alone.
Jin was also conserving his strength in anticipation of Rakiman using some trick.

'There are no signs of him using a return spell like Shimat did. I deliberately tied the other enemy tribes with the King's Domain. So, the secret techniques Rakiman can use would be Castleization or summoning.'

If it's Castleization, he can deal with it after gauging the combat power, and if it's summoning, no matter how many appear, he can just open the King's Domain more and sweep them all away. He could even use the magical sword of Runcandel, which he has been deliberately not using to show his dignity as the King's tribe.
However, considering the number of Kinzelo squad members that the enemy tribes have hunted so far, not many could be summoned. There didn't seem to be any other Grand Warriors awake besides Rakiman.
So, for Jin, it was a battle he could absolutely never lose. The recovery phase of the enemy tribes was not enough to compete with Jin in terms of pure strength.
As he continued to press Rakiman.
Jin noticed the bracelet on his arms glowing red. So he checked the fallen enemy tribes, but their hearts were not burning like when Shimat used the return spell.
'Ah, he's using a space storage, a summoning.'
Naturally, Jin thought that the enemy tribes would be summoned.
However, the energy pouring from Rakiman's bracelet the next moment was creating a huge hole in the sky. As if to open a passage that something much larger than a person could pass through.
Seeing what came out of it, Jin's eyes could only widen.
'...A fleet!?'
Over fifty of them, the fleet of the enemy tribes was positioned in the massive dimensional gate that Rakiman had opened.
"The strength of the enemy tribes comes from power and knowledge. I hear that most of the airborne ships on the ground now are near junk by the enemy tribes' standards."
Jin stopped the sword he was about to swing at Rakiman and aimed at the fleet. Rakiman gave orders to the bracelet with an expressionless face.
"Precise strike on the entire fleet, target Jin Runcandel."
{Enemy Tribes!}
The fleet's bombardment began immediately. Hundreds of red rays that twisted and curved like snakes, every single one of them was aimed precisely at Jin.
And Jin swung his sword with a slight smile, seemingly not intending to avoid the bombardment.
Before anyone knew it, the Third Combat Technique of Runcandel that was spread out, the Meteor Shower was intercepting the fleet's bombardment, reinforced with lightning.
[Rakiman, I thought at most you would summon more tribesmen, but I admit, this is surprising.]
For Rakiman, the sight of Jin effortlessly fending off even the fleet's bombardment was even more shocking.
